correction_to_prior_search: The earlier search inspected scripts/ and generic author IK code. The local bundle is in scripts (1)/. These concrete scripts improve recipe evidence; the earlier search did not establish that processing code was absent.

static_recipe.operation: Select the first subject static IK candidate. If absent, calculate static IK from the first static marker file and subject IK setup. Copy trial IK and replace columns 2 onward with trial IK minus the columnwise mean of static IK. The header column is unchanged.
limitations: First-file selection depends on file-manager ordering and available static calibrations. The intended AB17 session calibration remains unknown.
The subtraction has no explicit omitnan or angle wrapping.
The recovered v1 AB17 archive has no static trials, so the formula alone cannot supply missing offsets.
This local bundle has not yet been independently matched to a publisher archive.

mass_recipe.active_code: Loads ../SubjectInfo.mat, selects Weight by exact Subject equality as subjectMass, and divides id and jp by subjectMass. This is actual field-to-mass normalization code, not inference from plausible values.
mass_recipe.comment_only: STRIDES.m line 63 shows force normalization using subjectMass*9.81, but the line is commented and is not evidence of execution. The helper documents a force normalization denominator in newtons.
mass_recipe.remaining: Publisher-version equivalence of this local bundle and explicit kilogram evidence remain necessary before approving the recovered AB17 canonical mass.

plot_label_evidence.claim: Plot labels explicitly call moment Nm/kg and power W/kg. PLOTS.m lines 41,58,83 calls this helper. Together with active STRIDES division, this supports the local bundle intending Weight as a mass in kilograms; it does not prove original table units or publisher version.
plot_label_evidence.caution: Force label N/kg at line 30 does not establish active force normalization: the STRIDES force normalization line is commented. Do not use plotting labels as blanket correctness proof.
